cell.label: Active management of third stage of labor
Perform immediate postpartum bimanual examination and visual inspection to evaluate for ongoing blood loss and its potential cause.
Assess vital signs for hemodynamic compromise.
Perform bimanual uterine massage and assess its effect on uterine tone.
Give uterotonics and assess effect on uterine tone.
Perform visual inspection to evaluate for trauma.
Examine for any retained placental products via manual intrauterine examination or ultrasound (consider sedation prior to manual examination).
Evaluate for coagulopathies (consider especially in patients who are not forming clots).
Perform manual or surgical removal of retained placental products.
Appropriate resuscitative and stabilizing measures, including IVF and blood.
